tasks.label: Setup UI CLI venv
tasks.command: ([ -d ~/.venvs/ui-cli ] || python3 -m venv ~/.venvs/ui-cli) && source ~/.venvs/ui-cli/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt

tasks.label: Setup UI Streamlit venv
tasks.command: ([ -d ~/.venvs/ui-streamlit ] || python3 -m venv ~/.venvs/ui-streamlit) && source ~/.venvs/ui-streamlit/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
